subtitle: Lesson 12 · Deploying Compute & Storage

eyebrow: The concrete test: write it, read it back
code:
# Azure
echo "smoke test" > smoke-test.txt
az storage blob upload --account-name ltvappstorage01 \
  --container-name app-data --name smoke-test.txt \
  --file smoke-test.txt --auth-mode login
az storage blob download --account-name ltvappstorage01 \
  --container-name app-data --name smoke-test.txt \
  --file smoke-test-check.txt --auth-mode login

# AWS
aws s3 cp smoke-test.txt s3://ltv-app-prod-data/smoke-test.txt
aws s3 cp s3://ltv-app-prod-data/smoke-test.txt smoke-test-check.txt
caption: If the upload succeeds, the network path and identity grant both work.
A 200 OK confirms the app is actually running, not just that the VM is reachable.
